name: RW Aurigae
notes: Its brightest pixels overflow; their flux is recovered from the reads before the overflow (median ratio 1.04 to clean pixels over 10 pairs, range 1.00–1.51; see the tool's Methods page).

By the control-star test RW Aurigae changes between epochs in 6 of 6 bands: D1 ×1.40 (controls up to ×1.03, 5 stars), D2 ×1.37 (controls up to ×1.06, 5 stars), D3 ×1.46 (controls up to ×1.04, 5 stars), D4 ×1.17 (controls up to ×1.04, 5 stars), D5 ×1.94 (controls up to ×1.06, 5 stars), D6 ×1.64 (controls up to ×1.10, 5 stars). Most robust in D1, D2, D5, D6 (several wavelength bins); D3, D4 rest on a single wavelength bin.
processing: spx 0.1: FLAGS mask, local background, clipped inverse-variance mean per epoch and band, fixed 3 arcsec TAN grid (north up); data spherex_dr1, spherex_qr3
